import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
    G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def f(g):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # for each non-bg cell, check if part of solid same-color rectangle >= area? Use largest rectangle via scan per cell as anchor
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    best=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==bg: continue
            c=g[i][j]
            maxr=max(r for k in range(i,h) if all(g[k][j]==c for k in range(i,h)))
            maxr=min(maxr,(h-i))
            maxc=min(w-j, maxr)
            best.append((maxr*maxc,i,j,c,maxr,maxc))
    best.sort(reverse=True)
    area,best_i,best_j,best_c,_,_=best[0]
    for i in range(best_i,best_i+best):
        for j in range(best_j,best_j+best):
            out[i][j]=best_c
    return out
